title: EVERY RAID EVENT SOUNDS ITS START
why: His answer of 2026-10-14: the raid events come one or two a raid, and he never noticed them because he did not know what they were, so each one must be obvious when it starts: a clear alert with its name, a mark on the map and the minimap, and a distinct sound. The alert with the name, a short line and the seconds to go, and the pinned mark with its countdown on the minimap and the sector map were already there; the events started in silence. Each now has a sound of its own when its warning begins (a falling siren for orbital debris, two low horn calls for the convoy, three tolling bells for the bounty pillager, an icy chime over a hiss for the coolant rupture, a deep growl for the Overseer rampage) and a short double stab when it goes live. Player 2 hears and reads the same.
now: Every raid event now announces itself with a sound of its own.
